acquisition_method.evidence: Top20 CID method and a Top10 high-energy collision dissociation method

cleavage_agent.evidence: Prior to the MS analysis, samples were exposed for 2 h at 37 °C to trypsin digestion at a ratio of 1:20 (enzyme:substrate).

fragmentation_method.evidence: collision-induced fragmentation employing a Top20 CID method

instrument.evidence: The eluate was ionized by electrospray ionization using an Orbitrap Velos Pro (ThermoFisherScientific, UK) operating under Xcalibur v2.2.
